affected_party: QIF users and governance owners relying on calibration reports
actual_problem: An aggregate calibration score can conceal biased selection, repeated or dependent observations, missing outcomes, drift, and failure concentrated in a high-risk cohort.
why_it_matters: A mathematically correct aggregate can still mislead decisions when the cohort does not represent the intended claim or masks protected segments.
why_now: v0.6.31 made calibration arithmetic executable, exposing cohort integrity as the next binding limitation; current agent-evaluation guidance emphasizes balanced datasets, isolated trials, real usage patterns, and drift maintenance.
